hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT SEC non-management proxy-pressure filings (DFAN14A, PX14A6G, PREC14A, PRRN14A) may identify governance/control-pressure events that become positive only when signal-day liquid price action absorbs the event versus SPY before next-open paper entry.
acceptance_rule: docs/backtesting.md Gate 1-4 plus accepted compression/distribution comparator; replay-only positives require shared daily/backtest helper before retention

prediction.confidence_reason: Focused non-management proxy-pressure forms are a real free SEC submissions event surface with enough three-window coverage and are distinct from rejected 13D/13G ownership entries, 13F/Form144 delayed ownership, and generic 8-K/text labels. The likely disconfirmer is governance-event noise or the event being priced before next-open paper entry.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SEC submissions cache, missing CIK mapping, missing proxy pressure event rows, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT SEC DFAN14A/PX14A6G/PREC14A/PRRN14A events, acceptance-time signal date, price-absorption gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SEC non-management proxy-pressure absorption source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: aggregate_ev_not_positive, aggregate_pnl_not_positive, window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The fixed bundle tested DFAN14A/PX14A6G/PREC14A/PRRN14A proxy-pressure forms plus signal-day SPY-relative price absorption. The result is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta -0.1954; aggregate PnL delta $-2,121.50; max drawdown drift +0.0031; 39 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping DFAN14A/PX14A6G/PREC14A/PRRN14A form lists, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event-age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: If this fixed non-management proxy-pressure absorption bundle fails, do not retry by sweeping DFAN14A/PX14A6G/PREC14A/PRRN14A form lists, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event-age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
